summary.claim: Historical pressure-performance indicator; persistence not demonstrated. It describes IPL 2023–26; it is not a forecast (D15).
exec_summary: Pressure, defined ball by ball: how much one ball could swing the match result (win-probability leverage), lifted for chases, being below par, the death overs, playoffs and collapses. The top 20% of balls, ranked only against earlier balls, count as High pressure.

Performance under pressure: runs above (batters) or saved (bowlers) versus an average player in exactly the same situation, plus win probability added, holding up versus the player's own low-pressure level and consistency across seasons; small samples are pulled toward average.

Top 10 batters under pressure (IPL 2023–26): Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, Ashutosh Sharma, Shreyas Iyer, Heinrich Klaasen, Virat Kohli, Prabhsimran Singh, Marcus Stoinis, Sameer Rizvi, Abdul Samad, Venkatesh Iyer.
Top 10 bowlers under pressure (IPL 2023–26): Kuldeep Yadav, Jasprit Bumrah, Matheesha Pathirana, Patrick Cummins, Ravindra Jadeja, Krunal Pandya, Sunil Narine, Vyshak Kumar, Mohsin Khan, Lungi Ngidi.

How sure we are: the 80% ranges inside each top 10 overlap, so read each as a group, not a strict order. Tested one season ahead, the score did not beat simple strike-rate/economy rankings (batters 42.9% v 46.7%; bowlers 72.8% v 75.0%): it is a record of past pressure performance, not a forecast.
